title: IterCAD: An Iterative Multimodal Agent for Visually-Grounded CAD Generation and Editing
abstract: arXiv:2606.13368v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Computer-Aided Design is pivotal in modern manufacturing, yet existing automated methods predominantly rely on open-loop, one-shot generation, creating a mismatch with iterative real-world practices. In this paper, we present IterCAD, a unified multimodal agent framework for closed-loop, interactive CAD generation and editing. We formulate the task as a multi-turn interaction between a multimodal agent and an executable CAD sandbox, covering three tasks: Drawing-to-Code, Text-to-Code, and Interactive Editing. To support this, we develop a data synthesis pipeline incorporating advanced industrial manufacturing features to generate standard-compliant multi-view engineering drawings, complex code-editing tasks, and high-fidelity interaction trajectories. translated_title: IterCAD：一种用于视觉接地CAD生成与编辑的迭代式多模态智能体
translated_abstract: 计算机辅助设计（CAD）在现代制造业中至关重要，然而现有的自动化方法主要依赖开环的、一次性生成方式，这与现实世界中迭代式的实际工作流程存在不匹配。在本文中，我们提出了IterCAD，一个用于闭环、交互式CAD生成与编辑的统一多模态智能体框架。我们将该任务形式化为多模态智能体与可执行CAD沙箱之间的多轮交互，涵盖三项任务：图纸转代码、文本转代码和交互式编辑。为支持这一框架，我们开发了一条数据合成流水线，融合先进的工业制造特征，以生成符合标准的多视图工程图纸、复杂的代码编辑任务以及高保真的交互轨迹。我们通过渐进式监督微调（SFT）以及结合可行前缀掩码的几何感知强化学习来优化该智能体，从而提升代码的可执行性和几何保真度。最后，我们……
tldr: 本文提出IterCAD，一个通过多模态智能体与可执行CAD沙箱进行多轮交互来实现闭环交互式CAD生成与编辑的统一框架，并借助数据合成流水线、渐进式SFT和几何感知强化学习显著提升代码可执行性与几何保真度。
en_tdlr: IterCAD introduces a unified multimodal agent framework for closed-loop, interactive CAD generation and editing through multi-turn interaction with an executable CAD sandbox, enhanced by a data synthesis pipeline, progressive SFT, and geometry-aware reinforcement learning to improve code executability and geometric fidelity.
